title: Broncos are not trading, releasing or asking LG Ben Powers to take a pay cut

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos are not trading, releasing or asking LG Ben Powers to take a pay cut
sources.description: Denver Broncos left guard Ben Powers was rumored to be on the trade block, and there was some talk that the Broncos could be asking him to take a pay cut. These rumors heated up earlier tonight when it was announced that reserve linemen Alex Palczewski signed a two-year deal to stay with the team. […]
